decision.explanation: Three distinct composers created works titled Symphony No. 38: Joseph Haydn (in C major, Hoboken I/38), Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (in D major, K. 504, known as the Prague Symphony), and Michael Haydn (in F major, Perger 30). The claim attributing Symphony No. 38 to Beethoven is factually incorrect based on the provided text and historical record, as Beethoven did not compose a Symphony No. 38.
